dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: Um, at 8th Coy, we're responsible for a variety of battlefield support operations, including technology development in certain areas.

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: We're the ones who developed tech like the ranged weapons used by 5th Coy, and the latest defensive structures...

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: Mister Albedo and Miss Lisa have also been a great help to us. Unfortunately, one of them belongs to the Investigation Team, and the other doesn't want to head a support company...

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: I should also mention that among all the alchemical potions we developed together with them, the one most popular with the expeditionary force is our sobriety tonic. Our Grand Master has never used it, however.
